edges: The charge of leaking state secrets may allow authorities to shield certain legal proceedings from public view in Zhou's case.
Zhou's alleged actions have caused heavy losses to public assets.
Zhou attended an anniversary event at his alma mater in October 2013.
The president of China's supreme court stated there would be no trials for accused former leaders like Zhou.
Zhou and his family members have accumulated enormous wealth.
Zhou was notified of his legal rights during the investigation.
